extraction_notes: Values marked with qualifier '~' were read from plotted points in the provided figure images. Textual numbers were used preferentially where present: Ce and Al loadings of CeAlOx/Ni/Ni-foam (2.4 wt.% Ce and 2.5 wt.% Al), 13 wt% Ni for conventional Ni/oxide catalysts, 0.15 g catalyst charge, feed CO2:H2:N2 = 18:72:10, and pressure 0.1 MPa. CO2:H2 feed ratio was computed from the stated gas composition as H2/CO2 = 72/18 = 4. Fig. 2b selectivities at low temperature overlap near 100%; values were recorded only as approximate plot readings. Fig. 4 reports CH4 yield rather than CO2 conversion, so stability conversion fields are missing for those cycling records.
